description: This is a FastAPI application source file defining REST API endpoints for an Xbox Game Hub backend. It includes initialization, health check, game listing, game details, account registration, and login functionalities, along with middleware setup and dependency injections.

classes.name: GamesResponse
classes.description: Response schema for paginated list of games.

classes.name: GameListItem
classes.description: Schema representing a game item in lists (id, title, genre, thumbnail).

classes.name: GameDetail
classes.description: Schema for detailed game information, including description, screenshots, and metadata.

classes.name: APIError
classes.description: Schema for representing API error responses.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Standard response schema for authentication endpoints, includes success flag, message, account info, and token.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for registration request payload, includes email, username, password.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload, includes email/username and password.

classes.name: AccountResponse
classes.description: Schema for account details returned to clients.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: GamesResponse list_games( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search by title (case-insensitive)"), page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(default=12, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of games, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: GameDetail get_game_details(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific game by ID.

methods.name: AuthResponse register_account(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new demo account with validation for existing email/username.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email/username and password, returning a dummy token.

ctags.pattern: /^def get_game_details(game_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> GameDetail:$/

ctags.signature: ( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search by title (case-insensitive)"), page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(default=12, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AuthResponse:$/
